  "chapters": [
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "The Glass Cannon’s Guide to Not Dying",
      "goal": "Artie acquires the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion and begins exploiting the system's loot mechanics in the crypts.",
      "chapter_role": "setup",
      "stakes_shift": "From desperate survival to tactical exploitation of the system's physics and drop rates.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Artie escapes Vane but remains a one-hit-kill target.",
        "to_next": "Artie's rapid farming triggers the attention of the Floor Guardian."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 3,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 9
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Coward's Wardrobe",
          "intent": "Artie seeks gear to survive his 1 HP fragility and exploits a quest loophole.",
          "section_role": "setup",
          "end_condition": "Artie steals the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion from a locked starter chest.",
          "status": "locked",
          "target_scene_count": 3,
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "setup",
              "summary": "Artie wanders the Oakhaven market looking for defensive gear, but everything is either too expensive or level-locked, leaving him vulnerable.",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes standard merchants cannot solve his 1 HP problem.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Square",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Market",
              "location_start": "The bustling central square of Oakhaven",
              "location_end": "A row of overpriced armor stalls in the market",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie catches his breath among the crowded market stalls, scanning for armor vendors.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "crowded market stalls",
                "smell of roasted meat",
                "clinking armor plates"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie turns away from the laughing merchant, his empty pockets offering no solutions.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "laughing merchant",
                "empty pockets",
                "gleaming steel breastplate"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2",
              "seam_score": 100,
              "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "conflict",
              "summary": "Fizz points out a 'Starter Quest' loophole involving an allegedly unbreakable display chest meant to teach players about lockpicking.",
              "outcome": "Artie decides to bypass the quest requirements and just break the chest.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Market",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Quest Board",
              "location_start": "A row of overpriced armor stalls in the market",
              "location_end": "The crowded plaza in front of the Adventurer's Guild",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Fizz projects a glowing blue waypoint leading away from the market toward the guild plaza.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "glowing blue waypoint",
                "cobblestone path",
                "wooden guild sign"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie steps up to the heavy display chest, ignoring the warning signs.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "heavy display chest",
                "painted warning sign",
                "rusty iron dagger"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3",
              "seam_score": 100,
              "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "climax",
              "summary": "Artie strikes the 'indestructible' lock, triggering a massive critical hit that shatters it, allowing him to loot the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion.",
              "outcome": "Artie steals the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion from a locked starter chest.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Quest Board",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Alleyway",
              "location_start": "The crowded plaza in front of the Adventurer's Guild",
              "location_end": "A shadowed alley behind the guild hall",
              "handoff_mode": "aftermath_relocation",
              "constraint_state": "fleeing",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie raises his rusty dagger and brings it down hard on the indestructible lock.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "rusty iron dagger",
                "indestructible lock",
                "sparking metal"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie wraps the oversized cloak around his shoulders and ducks into a nearby alley before the guards arrive.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "oversized lion cloak",
                "shadowed alley",
                "shouting guild guards"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie steals the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion from a locked starter chest.",
              "seam_score": 100,
              "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Loot Pinata Theory",
          "intent": "Artie enters the crypts and discovers how his crits break the loot drop system.",
          "section_role": "conflict",
          "end_condition": "Artie clears a room of skeletons, turning them into a mountain of loot.",
          "status": "locked",
          "target_scene_count": 3,
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "setup",
              "summary": "Artie enters the Oakhaven Crypts, testing his new Cloak of the Cowardly Lion to sneak past high-level mobs, but accidentally aggros a skeleton.",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes the cloak's stealth is flawed but his 100% crit still applies to basic attacks.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Alleyway",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Crypts Entrance",
              "location_start": "A shadowed alley behind the guild hall",
              "location_end": "The damp entrance to the Oakhaven Crypts",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie slips out of the shadowed alleyway, following Fizz's glowing waypoint toward the low-level crypts on the edge of town.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "oversized lion cloak",
                "damp stone steps",
                "flickering torchlight"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie steps on a brittle femur, drawing the glowing red eyes of a skeletal guard.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "brittle femur bone",
                "glowing red eyes",
                "rusty iron sword"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5",
              "seam_score": 100,
              "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "conflict",
              "summary": "Artie panics and throws a random rock at the skeleton, triggering a massive critical hit that shatters it into an absurd amount of loot.",
              "outcome": "Artie discovers that his crits force enemies to drop their entire loot table at once.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Crypts Entrance",
              "location_end_label": "Crypt Antechamber",
              "location_start": "The damp entrance to the Oakhaven Crypts",
              "location_end": "A small antechamber inside the crypts",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie scrambles backward across the damp stone as the skeleton lunges, grabbing a loose rock from the floor.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "loose rock",
                "lunging skeleton",
                "rusty iron sword"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie stares at the mountain of gold coins and rare bone fragments burying the shattered skeleton.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "mountain of gold coins",
                "glowing bone fragments",
                "dusty crypt floor"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:6",
              "seam_score": 100,
              "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "climax",
              "summary": "Realizing the exploit, Artie systematically clears the antechamber by throwing pebbles at a horde of skeletons, creating a massive pile of loot.",
              "outcome": "Artie clears a room of skeletons, turning them into a mountain of loot.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:5",
              "location_start_label": "Crypt Antechamber",
              "location_end_label": "Crypt Antechamber",
              "location_start": "A small antechamber inside the crypts",
              "location_end": "A small antechamber inside the crypts",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie scoops up a handful of gravel, eyeing the next group of skeletons with a greedy grin.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "handful of gravel",
                "shambling skeletons",
                "mountain of gold coins"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie sits atop his new hoard, ignoring the deep rumbling echoing from the lower crypt levels.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "massive loot pile",
                "deep rumbling sound",
                "shaking stone walls"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:7",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie clears a room of skeletons, turning them into a mountain of loot.",
              "seam_score": 100,
              "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Summoning Trouble",
          "intent": "Vane's interference forces Artie to take a massive risk for XP.",
          "section_role": "climax",
          "end_condition": "Artie activates the Boss Trigger left behind by Vane.",
          "status": "locked",
          "target_scene_count": 3,
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "setup",
              "summary": "Artie and Fizz investigate the rumbling deeper in the crypts, discovering that Vane has been clearing the lower levels and left behind a high-level Boss Trigger item to farm later.",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes Vane is using the crypts as a personal farming ground and spots the Boss Trigger.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "location_start_label": "Crypt Antechamber",
              "location_end_label": "Lower Crypt Boss Room",
              "location_start": "A small antechamber inside the crypts",
              "location_end": "A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie slides down the mountain of gold coins, following the deep rumbling sound deeper into the dark stone corridor.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "mountain of gold coins",
                "deep rumbling sound",
                "dark stone corridor"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie peers around a shattered stone pillar, spotting the glowing Boss Trigger resting on an obsidian pedestal.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "shattered stone pillar",
                "glowing Boss Trigger",
                "obsidian pedestal"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "type": "conflict",
              "summary": "Fizz warns Artie that activating the Boss Trigger will summon a creature far beyond his level, but Artie calculates the massive XP payout and decides the risk is worth it to out-level Vane's threat.",
              "outcome": "Artie decides to steal Vane's boss kill to gain a massive XP boost.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "location_start_label": "Lower Crypt Boss Room",
              "location_end_label": "Lower Crypt Boss Room",
              "location_start": "A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts",
              "location_end": "A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Fizz projects a flashing red warning screen over the glowing Boss Trigger, detailing the suicidal level gap.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "flashing red warning screen",
                "glowing Boss Trigger",
                "obsidian pedestal"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie dismisses the warning screen with a swipe of his hand, stepping up to the obsidian pedestal.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "dismissed warning screen",
                "obsidian pedestal",
                "raised hand"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "type": "climax",
              "summary": "Artie ignores Fizz's frantic warnings and slams his hand onto the Boss Trigger, locking the room and initiating the summoning sequence for the Floor Guardian.",
              "outcome": "Artie activates the Boss Trigger left behind by Vane.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:8",
              "location_start_label": "Lower Crypt Boss Room",
              "location_end_label": "Lower Crypt Boss Room",
              "location_start": "A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts",
              "location_end": "A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie steps up to the obsidian pedestal, ignoring Fizz's frantic beeping.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "obsidian pedestal",
                "frantic beeping",
                "glowing Boss Trigger"
              ],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie activates the Boss Trigger left behind by Vane."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
